status: draft: fields checked against live OpenAlex, DataCite (schema 4.5+, incl. StudyRegistration) and OpenAIRE Graph v1 responses; pending review by research assessment experts
principles: Each indicator is reported on its own, with its evidence and its limits. There is no composite score.
An indicator that cannot be verified from the sources consulted is reported as unverifiable, never as zero.
Indicators describe open practices; they do not measure research quality.

families.name: Accessibility
families.question: Are they kept accessible in the long term?

families.name: Declared reproducibility
families.question: Are data and code shared alongside publications?

families.name: Methodological transparency
families.question: Are methods and early results shared openly?

indicators.name: Open access share of publications
indicators.definition: Share of the researcher's publications that are free to read in any form (gold, diamond, hybrid, bronze or green).
indicators.rationale: Open access to publications is the most established open science practice and a baseline in DORA- and CoARA-aligned assessment.
indicators.numerator: OpenAlex works of type article, review, book, book-chapter or conference-paper with open_access.is_oa = true
limitations: Depends on OpenAlex author disambiguation by ORCID iD.
Coverage is weaker for books, humanities and non-English outputs.
Bronze (free to read on the publisher site without a licence) can be withdrawn.

indicators.name: Repository copy share
indicators.definition: Share of publications with a full text in at least one repository (green route).
indicators.rationale: A repository copy keeps a publication accessible independently of the publisher's policy.
indicators.numerator: OpenAlex works of the same types with open_access.any_repository_has_fulltext = true
limitations: Only repositories indexed by OpenAlex are seen.
Does not check the licence of the repository copy.

indicators.name: Open access right in OpenAIRE
indicators.definition: Share of research products in the OpenAIRE Graph whose best access right is OPEN ACCESS.
indicators.rationale: A second, independent source on access rights, covering datasets and software as well as publications.
indicators.numerator: OpenAIRE products with bestAccessRight.label = OPEN ACCESS
indicators.denominator: OpenAIRE products linked to the ORCID iD
limitations: Only products where OpenAIRE links an author to the ORCID iD.
Access rights depend on repository metadata.

indicators.name: Datasets shared with a DOI
indicators.definition: Number of datasets with a DataCite DOI whose metadata identify the researcher by ORCID iD.
indicators.rationale: Sharing data in a repository with a persistent identifier is a precondition for findability and reuse.
limitations: Only datasets whose metadata carry the ORCID iD.
A count is not comparable across disciplines with different data practices.

indicators.name: Software shared with a DOI
indicators.definition: Number of software releases or notebooks with a DataCite DOI whose metadata identify the researcher by ORCID iD.
indicators.rationale: Archived, citable software is part of the research record.
indicators.numerator: DataCite DOIs with resourceTypeGeneral = Software or ComputationalNotebook
limitations: Code shared only on GitHub without an archived DOI is not seen.
Each version may have its own DOI, so counts can include versions.

indicators.name: Shared data and software cited
indicators.definition: Share of the researcher's datasets and software (DataCite DOIs) cited at least once according to DataCite.
indicators.rationale: Citation of shared data and software is a visible, if partial, trace of reuse.
indicators.numerator: DataCite datasets and software with citationCount > 0
limitations: Data citation is still rare and unevenly recorded.
Reuse without citation is invisible.
Self-citations are not excluded.

indicators.name: Data and software outputs per publication
indicators.definition: Ratio of shared datasets and software (DataCite) to publications (OpenAlex).
indicators.rationale: A rough proxy for how often publications come with their underlying data or code.
indicators.denominator: OpenAlex works of type article, review, book, book-chapter or conference-paper
limitations: It does not verify that a dataset belongs to a given publication.
Theoretical and qualitative fields legitimately produce fewer data outputs.

indicators.name: Preprint share
indicators.definition: Share of the researcher's works in OpenAlex that are preprints.
indicators.rationale: Preprints make results and methods open to scrutiny before formal peer review.
limitations: Preprint and published versions may be merged into one work.
Preprint culture differs strongly across disciplines.

indicators.name: Study registrations
indicators.definition: Number of study registrations and preregistrations with a DataCite DOI identifying the researcher.
indicators.rationale: Registering hypotheses and analysis plans before data collection is a core transparency practice.
limitations: Registries without DataCite DOIs (for example many clinical trial registries) are not seen.
Only meaningful for empirical, hypothesis-testing research.
